Launch that one straight upward, then fall down and dash right through the gap in the spinners to reach the berry.

keywords: Dash into the spinner gap as the wind carries you
steps.detail: In the ninth room, and very straightforward. As the wind carries you right, you can see this strawberry in a small gap in the spinners — dash straight into it, then up-right into the green bubble, and complete the room normally from there.

keywords: Avoid the purple orb at the room's end
Dash right into the cracked wall
steps.detail: In the eleventh room. At the end of the room, where the Badeline booster would carry you to the next subchapter, avoid the purple orb and dash right underneath it into the suspicious cracked wall with no spinners on it. The strawberry is hidden in that area.

keywords: Ride the first red bubble left
Swap block fling, dash left then right
steps.detail: Riding the first red bubble left — or simply dashing into the smashable wall it breaks — reaches a room with this strawberry. Stand on the bridge above and dash onto the floor, then quickly run off the bridge and land in the red bubble. Take it left and, as soon as you reach the wall, jump right and grab the swap block. Let go right as it arrives back at the top and you are flung into the air. With both dashes available in the section above, dash left to get the berry, then dash back right to claim it.

keywords: First Red Booster left through the wall
Ride the second booster until it crashes
steps.detail: The sixth and final gem is at 2500 M. Take the first Red Booster and head left, smashing through the wall — or simply dash into the left wall. Then take another Red Booster right, smashing through the walls. Stay in the bubble until it crashes, then head up into a long horizontal room; complete it to find the final gem. The gem is a reference to the ancient exile from TowerFall.

keywords: Dash down through the spike gap from the bubble
steps.detail: In the first room, in the middle of the room under the usual red bubble path. Dash straight down into the gap in the spikes as you pass it in the red bubble, then dash diagonally up-right to land on the disappearing platform. Jump up and do an upward, then diagonally up-right dash out of the area to another disappearing platform, then dash into the nearby red bubble.

keywords: Left side of the key room above room 5
Take the red bubble path two rooms below
steps.detail: In the same room as the key above the fifth room, but on the left side instead of the right. Take the red bubble path two rooms below on the left to get to the strawberry's location.

keywords: Ride the first red bubble straight up
Spring onto the half-returned swap block
steps.detail: At the start of the sixth room, ride the first red bubble straight up to reveal a hidden path above. The strawberry is at the end of the first room you enter, above a disappearing platform. Make your way to the spring on the right and try to grab the wall above it. When the swap block is about halfway back to its original position, bounce on the spring and hold onto the swap block; from there you can dash to the berry.

keywords: Swap block launch, then time the blades
steps.detail: After finishing the room holding the previous strawberry, two more rooms have to be completed. In the first, carefully time jumping and dashing up into dash switches while avoiding blades, then do the same again with springs. The strawberry is in the second room after. Its first challenge just has you dashing on a swap block and launching yourself forward by jumping right after; then comes some careful dash timing around blades.

keywords: Hidden passage under the launching swap block
steps.detail: In the twelfth room, in a hidden area near the middle. Below the swap block that is meant to launch you up to the last two swap blocks, a hidden passage is revealed by entering from the left side.

keywords: Dash switch top-left of the red booster
Second switch behind the top-right gate
steps.detail: Right by the red bubble you ride up into the purple orb are a few secret areas. To the top-left of the red booster is a dash switch. To the top-right is a temple gate that the switch opens, protecting another dash switch. To the bottom-right of the red bubble, this strawberry sits behind a temple gate that the top-right dash switch unlocks.
To the bottom-left of the red bubble at the end of the twelfth room, the wall reveals a hidden section with this strawberry.

keywords: Dash right into it, then up to the refill
steps.detail: Amid flag 26's platforming, this strawberry floats under a platform. Dash right into it, then straight up, and touch the nearby dash refill to continue onward and claim it.

keywords: End of flag 24, left of flag 23's entry
Jump right at the top of the wall
steps.detail: At the end of flag 24, a strawberry sits to the left of where flag 23 would be entered. From the crumble block below, jump left and dash leftward, then start climbing the wall. At the top of the wall, jump right to get the strawberry and clear the spikes, then dash right to land on the crumble block and get to safety.

keywords: Spring up the thin floating platform
steps.detail: Near the start of flag 21, above the normal path among some spikes. Bounce off the spring and dash straight up to climb the right side of the thin floating platform. Jump and dash into the strawberry, then jump back left. Finally, jump over the floating platform and keep going left to get back to the flag.

keywords: Full bounce off the cloud, over the spinners
steps.detail: To the left of flag 18 is a section with a lot of spinners and this strawberry. Do a full bounce up from the nearby cloud and move left, over the spinners. Using your two dashes, carefully time boosting yourself up to reach the strawberry without touching the spinners. Afterwards, fall into the dash refill and make your way back to the cloud.

keywords: Diagonal dash in, then wrap the wall
steps.detail: A strawberry hovers to the bottom-right of flag 16. Do a diagonal dash into it after falling from the bridge, then diagonally dash the other way and wrap Madeline around the thin section of wall to grab its left side and climb back up to safety.

keywords: Left of flag 15, past the spinner wall
steps.detail: To the left of flag 15, beyond the tall wall of spinners, this berry floats near the left wall. Do a full jump and then dash diagonally up-left over the spinners to reach the strawberry, then climb the wall and dash diagonally up-right back over the spinners.

keywords: Bring a feather up from flag 4 or down from flag 3
Dash up-left over the spinner block
steps.detail: This strawberry hovers above the main path of flag 4, though it is worth reaching flag 3 as a breather point before going for it. A feather is needed to reach the area. If you go for the berry while completing flag 4, the feather used there can be carried upward to reach the small disappearing platform; if you go after saving at flag 3, the feather found just above can be brought down and to the left to give access. Jump onto the small disappearing platform, dash diagonally up-left over the block of spinners, and grab the left side of the floating platform. From there, jump to the disappearing platforms on the left and reach the strawberry, then ride the feather below onward as normal and claim the strawberry when you land.

keywords: Enter through the gap under the wall
steps.detail: Only accessible once all six gems are collected. The heart is at 3000 M, in a hidden room just right of flag 28, behind a wall with a small gap beneath it. This is the hardest-to-find crystal heart in the game; collecting it earns Pink Sunrise.
The last subchapter counts its checkpoint flags down from 30 to 01 as you ascend. Reaching the top completes Chapter 7 and earns the Celeste achievement for climbing Celeste Mountain.
Unlocked by the chapter's cassette tape. Seven checkpoints, mirroring the A-Side's Start through 3000 M, and no red strawberries. Completing it earns No More Running.

chapters.title: Epilogue
chapters.intro: The final chapter of the main game, after Madeline's descent from the peak. It is the shortest chapter in Celeste — almost entirely cutscene, with no way to die and no speedrun timer. Nothing here counts toward the 32 achievements, but it must be played: Core and its five strawberries only become accessible after the Epilogue.

steps.detail: There is effectively no gameplay and no way to die here, and the speedrun timer neither shows nor runs. Walking or dashing left in front of Granny's cabin triggers the ending cutscene. To the right of the room where Madeline first spawns is the bridge, now much sturdier than its Prologue form; crossing it leads to a secret room with a bird's nest and a few multicoloured birds. Nothing here counts toward the 32 achievements, but the Epilogue must be played — Core and its five strawberries only become accessible afterwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Core
chapters.intro: Core is locked behind a Heart Door: four crystal hearts to enter the A-Side, 15 for the B-Side and 23 for the C-Side. Its gimmick is that dashes no longer refill on touching the ground — only screen transitions, dash refills and some entities give them back — layered over a hot/cold switch that flips magma blocks, fireballs and conveyor walls into ice. In scope: 5 red strawberries, the crystal heart, the cassette tape, and the A- and B-Side clears.

keywords: Switch the Core to cold first
steps.detail: To the left of the fifth room is a room with this strawberry floating far to the left near some fireballs. It is completely out of reach while the room is hot — though it can technically be obtained with a precise skip — so turn the Core to cold and come back. The hot bumper above the starting area will have become a bumper you can dash into diagonally up-right, bouncing you over to the ice balls on the left. Bounce across those carefully to collect the strawberry, then make your way back right and use your other dash to return.

keywords: Hit the hot/cold switch, bounce back left
Dash up to the vertical transition
steps.detail: At the end of the first room, a transition at the top of the right side is blocked by a magma barrier. To get past it, continue into the next room until you reach the hot/cold switch, hit it, and bounce back left on the ice balls it creates. Get back to the first room of the subchapter, then dash up to the vertical transition. In the room above, many bumpers sit over a spike floor, with corridors above them surrounded by ice walls; this strawberry is in the farthest right of those ice wall corridors. There are many ways in, but the most reliable is to walljump off the floating platform's ice walls to get to the bumper area without using a dash, then use both dashes to reach the strawberry. You can also barely reach the area by bouncing on the rightmost bumper and walljumping. From there, bounce on the top-left side of the right bumper and move left safely, returning to the start with either the earlier walljumping or a risky bounce on the left side of the leftmost bumper.

keywords: Third room, at the top of the end
Dash straight up off the last bumper
steps.detail: In the third room, at the end of the room floating at the top. After being bounced by the last bumper in the room, you should be in range to dash straight up into the strawberry and collect it.

keywords: Enter while the room is HOT
Bounce the ice balls to the switch first
steps.detail: Above the fourth room, reached through a small hole not far to the left of the hot/cold switch. It is easy to enter while the room is cold, but that blocks the strawberry off with an ice barrier and forces you to go left and restart the prior room — you need to enter while it is hot. Bounce on some ice balls near the hot/cold switch while still holding both dashes to reach it and set the room to hot. Then start moving left with dashes, stalling properly until there is an opening past any fireballs. After that the berry is there to collect, and you can head right to fall to the end of the lower room.

keywords: Seventh room, right of the last launching block
steps.detail: In the seventh room, hovering to the right of the last launching block. It looks very hard to approach, since normally you run out of time or stamina and fall into the magma below. The key: after being flung from the launching block on the left, use your other dash to get to where the strawberry floats, then walljump up — do NOT hold the climb button while doing this, or you will activate the launching block. Just walljump back and forth and jump above the top of the launching block so you can grab its left side and finish the room, claiming the strawberry.
Core's Crystal Heart and Cassette Tape are both at the end of the level, and collecting them is necessary to complete it. Collecting the cassette unlocks Core's B-Side.

Also at the end of the level, alongside the cassette; collecting them is necessary to complete Core. This is the eighth and last of the A-Side crystal hearts, and it earns the Heart of the Mountain achievement.
Reaching the end of Core completes Chapter 8. With the seven earlier crystal hearts plus this one, all eight A-Side hearts are now in hand.

Unlocked by Core's cassette tape, and gated behind a Heart Door requiring 15 crystal hearts. Four checkpoints — Start, Into the Core, Burning or Freezing and Heartbeat — and no red strawberries. Completing it earns Say Goodbye, and it is what unlocks the C-Sides.

chapters.title: C-Sides
chapters.intro: C-Sides unlock after completing Chapter 8's B-Side, which in turn requires every other B-Side — so the whole set is played after the A- and B-Side run is done. Each is short, three to four rooms with no checkpoints, and considerably harder than the A- and B-Sides; each ends with a Yellow Crystal Heart. Clearing all eight earns Thanks For Playing. Core's C-Side sits behind a 23-heart door, and completing the other seven is what opens the Crystal Heart Gate inside it.

steps.detail: A single checkpoint, three to four rooms, ending in a Yellow Crystal Heart. No red strawberries. Counts toward Thanks For Playing, which needs all eight C-Sides.
