chapters.title: Chapter 9: Farewell
chapters.intro: The final chapter, and the longest and hardest in the game. Released as a free content update in 2019, it has a space-themed setting and introduces double dash refills, pufferfish and jellyfish, mixed with mechanics from every other chapter. Farewell has no B- or C-Side and no red strawberries. Two things here are in scope: finishing the chapter, and the Moon Berry in the final checkpoint. Its Event Horizon checkpoint opens with a Heart Door needing 15 hearts.

steps.detail: Aside from a few trivial clouds and floating platforms, the first checkpoint has no real gameplay. It serves to remove Madeline's second dash and to set up the chapter's story. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

The first room introduces the double dash refill, which gives two dashes but only once — Madeline gets just one dash back on touching the ground afterwards. The first three rooms are fairly straightforward; the next three are much harder, rivalling many C-Side rooms. The seventh room introduces pufferfish, and the second half of the checkpoint showcases their various properties. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

keywords: Find the 5 keys in the maze
steps.detail: This checkpoint introduces jellyfish, which work as parachutes. The first room has a noticeable split path — the top one is meant for speedrunners, needing a wavedash the game has not taught yet. A few more rooms teach jellyfish properties, then you reach a huge room full of electricity where a red bubble appears and you must find 5 keys to clear its path upwards. Each of the five side rooms ends in a key and teaches a further jellyfish technique. Riding the red bubble up and out of the maze ends the checkpoint. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

The background turns from dark indigo to a lighter blue and the music changes. A new gauntlet of rooms follows, most containing a jellyfish or a pufferfish, harder than most B-Side rooms. The checkpoint ends at a fake grey Crystal Heart entitled "Empty Space" — src-tracker-maps pins it here as a crystal heart, but it is not one of the 24 the achievements need and nothing in scope is recorded in this checkpoint.

The game starts glitching, the background briefly flickering to a dark void. The very first room holds a Heart Door requiring 15 hearts — all 8 blue hearts plus every B-Side except Core's — though it is bypassable. The second room is the "Internet Café", whose computer plays a presentation teaching the wavedash, followed by three tutorial sections that show exactly how to complete them. After catching the Bird, lightning strikes and the level enters its permanent "glitch" state; from there the rooms draw on mechanics from essentially every previous chapter and get steadily harder. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

Essentially a continuation of Event Horizon, using almost every mechanic in the game in new and creative ways. This checkpoint and Event Horizon are considered the most difficult in Farewell. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

The background darkens and the music goes quiet and ominous. Cassette blocks return from the B-Sides, this time in four colours rather than two, and a series of challenges is built on them. The last three rooms run at a different tempo than the default — the first time in the game that happens. At 7 rooms this checkpoint is relatively short. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

The first room is another cassette block screen, ending with Madeline catching the Bird again; after a discussion with Badeline the background lights up. A long series of levels follows, reintroducing the jellyfish and pufferfish last seen in Remembered. The first half is a relative break in difficulty, the second half harder. The background vortex gradually brightens to pink while the music moves through four increasingly intense stages. Nothing in scope for the 32 achievements is recorded here.

keywords: Go left after the final power box
Die to reach the jellyfish room
steps.detail: After breaking the final power box, go left, which lets you jump off the floating blocks scattered around the massive room. They reveal an alternate path to a secret room where you have to perform a spawn exploit — die to spinners, or retry — to reach the next room, a long jellyfish challenge room. At its very end are a few floating platforms with the Moon Berry floating right above them. Collecting it earns the Wow achievement. Afterwards you can take the Badeline booster to the ending cutscene. Note that if you reach the Moon Berry room while carrying a golden berry, the golden temporarily detaches and moves to the next spawnpoint, because of the death exploit needed to continue.

The final checkpoint is a single room — excluding secrets — and the longest room in the game; expect 1.5 to 2 hours on a first attempt. Binoculars let you partially see it. Completing Farewell earns the Farewell achievement.

rows.label: Chapter 1: Forsaken City — Cassette Tape
rows.note: Right at the Chasm checkpoint — move the block aside, go up, then behind the wall-stuck zipper. Unlocks 1B, and is the earliest point for the Gateway achievement.

rows.label: Chapter 2: Old Site — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Start, after the mirror shatters and the dream blocks activate. Dash down through the dream block in the floor at the centre of the central room.

rows.label: Chapter 3: Celestial Resort — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Elevator Shaft, left of the key in the seventh room, through a hole in the wall with light coming through it.

rows.label: Chapter 4: Golden Ridge — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Start, top-left of the tenth room. Jump the clouds, go back left and dash up; continue left past the seeded-strawberry room.

rows.label: Chapter 5: Mirror Temple — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Depths, past the third Temple Gate. A red bubble leads to three dash-switch rooms; the cassette room is through cracked wall at the bottom right of the third.

rows.label: Chapter 6: Reflection — Cassette Tape
rows.note: At the beginning of Hollows, same section as the Crystal Heart. Crash the Kevin Block into the far-left wall to open the hidden entrance.

rows.label: Chapter 7: The Summit — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In 1500 M, fifth room — an opening in the ceiling leads to the cassette room.

rows.label: Chapter 8: Core — Cassette Tape
rows.note: At the end of the level, alongside the Crystal Heart. Collecting both is necessary to complete Core.

cells.how: The first strawberry is on the second screen of the subchapter. Jump up off the spring and dash upwards to reach it, then land back on the ground.
On the third screen. Jump off the block at the end of the room and collect the berry, then dash up straight away to avoid dropping into the spike pit, and grab the wall above.

On the fourth screen; this is a flying strawberry. Use the disappearing platforms at the right of the screen to jump up to the top, then jump off the left side to collect the berry. A speedrun-specific alternative uses Wallbounces. Sources disagree on the berry type: src-ink-collectables describes two winged strawberries in Forsaken City, src-tracker-maps marks only one — treat the type as unconfirmed.

In the room after the flying strawberry, go left when you find the glowing light. Behind a small challenge, scale a short ice wall with a few spikes here and there; dashing rightwards after falling down, at the left, nets you the berry.
Boost off the zipper left-upwards and climb onto the right side of the ice block with spikes on top. Jump off upwards, then dash left-upright to collect the strawberry.

In the same room as strawberry 5. Instead of heading upwards using the spring — the normal way to progress — head downwards, leaning on the right wall. An ice block can be seen: dash on it to destroy the block. In the room that follows, jump downwards, dash onto and hold the zipper, and jump onto it as it stops; then jump to where the strawberry is. Jump off leftwards and dash up-left, through the floor, to get back to safety.

Instead of going right in the first room of Crossing, go left into the room, dash into the dash refill and dash again, then climb up to the next screen. Jump over the first spring and jump on the second one, grab the wall and jump above it, then dash diagonally into the refill in the upper left corner and repeat the dash. Theo can also be found right after the berry, or by going left instead of up.

At the start of Crossing, go on the higher platform, jump and dash diagonally into the upper right corner, collecting the refill, and dash to the right again. Then, instead of going up, dash into the first block under the exit of the screen — that makes an exit appear into a small hidden path with the berry.

In the third room of Crossing — the one with two zippers, one heading right straight into spikes and the other heading upwards — use the first zipper normally, jump onto the second one, and boost up-leftwards to where an "up arrow" sign can be seen. From there, head left and continue through another, relatively harder, room with two zippers. Once you are outside of the city and can hear the "Piano Only" version of First Steps, jump and dash left until you find the satellite, collecting the strawberry on your way. The Crystal Heart is at that same satellite — do it now, in the next step.

In the fourth room of the sub-chapter, go up with the spring and dash into the block of ice, revealing a small room. Dash diagonally into the upper left corner three times, grab the berry, walljump into the refill, then dash diagonally into the upper right corner into the refill and do the same again.

Reach the room mentioned for strawberry 10, but instead of heading back after getting that berry, climb up on a floating block and dash into an odd-looking tile on the ceiling, leading you to a secret room. After beating it you enter another room where you can find the berry, then go back to the main route.

In the seventh room after the checkpoint you can find a small hole in the ground, which you can dash into instead of dashing onto the crumbling blocks. In the room you just entered, jump on the 3 zipper blocks, grab the berry, and wait a bit on the wall for the traffic light blocks to come back to their original position before coming back to the entrance.

The strawberry is located again in room 7, but this time, instead of going to the right to leave the room, go up and find another section with the berry. Grab the zipper block and climb onto the wall. If you jump off the traffic light block you will immediately get launched into spikes; jump on the other, smaller zipper instead, and when it reaches its leftmost point, jump off of it, grab the wall, and walljump off it to get the berry.

In the eighth room, jump on the edge of the first zipper and use the boost from jumping off of it while it is going up to jump between the spikes surrounding the berry, dashing up if necessary to grab it.

In the ninth and final room of Crossing, jump off a 2-tile wide platform and dash up to grab the zipper from the right side. When the zipper is on the right side, jump off of it to quickly grab the berry, then jump back on the zipper and jump up.

At the first room of Chasm, go left by grabbing the zipper and jump-dashing over it. Go into the room and take the down path by dashing over the zipper. Then go on the spring in the next room and jump on it, then quickly jump down on the platform and go up. When outside, just jump down and dash back up after walljumping. Then go back right by jumping down to the platform, dashing to the spring, and dashing after the spike platform.
Follow the same path as for the previous berry, but go up from the first room instead of left. Dash up into the traffic light block and launch yourself into the strawberry.
Found in the first room. Fall off of the right bridge and move right, then dash straight up, allowing you to reach the strawberry.

Found to the right of the first room. Ride the traffic light block and jump off it once it reaches its furthest point, to either land on the disappearing platform or grab the right wall. You can then go left after reaching the platform and bounce off the spring, into reach of the strawberry. Sources disagree on the berry type: src-ink-collectables calls this a winged strawberry, src-tracker-maps marks only one winged berry in Forsaken City — treat the type as unconfirmed.

In the fourth room you can find a transition in the top-left, by going through the wall behind a falling platform. In the room with the strawberry, dash into the dash crystal above you and continue dashing into the other dash crystals all around the platform, grabbing the berry on the left and then continuing back right.
In the same room as the mirror, but out of view without binoculars. To reach it, stay on the falling platform in the previous room and then go right into a hidden gap, which lets you grab the berry.
In the eighth room, to the top-left of the mirror room. The strawberry is in a hidden area above the middle of the 3 dream blocks; dash upward through that dream block to reach it.

The first seeded strawberry of the game. To collect a seeded berry, do not touch the floor before you have collected all of its strawberry seeds. The room is a tall one, accessed from the upper two left transitions in the fourth room. Keep yourself airborne by dashing into any nearby dream blocks as they move and you can get all the seeds.

In the room below the previous berry's room, past a smashable wall in the floor — or from the bottom left transition in the fourth room. Approached from above it is simple. It is possible to reach the berry from below, but you should be smashing the floor in the room above to access it with no challenge.

In the fourth room, and it needs care: the berry hovers in the upper area surrounded by many spikes. Position yourself to dash diagonally downward into the area it sits in, then either dash straight upward immediately or grab the wall and dash straight upward from there, to be safe as you collect it.

Go through the transition to the right of the previous berry's room and the sixth berry comes into view. Dash upward diagonally to land on the traffic light block, then dash directly right so you stop while the traffic light block is also stopped on the right. Dash from there to the strawberry and climb up to safety.

In the room right of the previous berry's room. The safest approach is to dash right after jumping into the dream block, then dash diagonally upward into the next one and grab the wall. After collecting the strawberry, climb higher and dash left twice through the dream blocks to get back.

Hidden in the floor of berry 6's room is a transition. Line yourself up with the hole and dash straight down to get in. That takes you to a hidden tunnel above an earlier room, which contains this strawberry.

Found by backtracking to the second room and going straight up the dream block, then right, arriving above the third room. To collect the berry, dash directly right into the upper dream block and then the lower one. Climb up to get the berry, then dash left twice and climb the wall on your way back to claim the strawberry.

In the second room, this strawberry forces you to detour from the exit by going up-right from the dream block. For the most consistent collect, dash right into the berry, climb up and wait a bit, then jump back left.

In the third room you can see this strawberry inside a wall with no obvious way in. To reach the area, dash straight left from the right side of the dream block just above the spikes. To make sure Badeline does not hit you, grab the berry and cling to the right wall, then dash to the left wall as she approaches and escape as normal.
In the sixth room, the berry is in the top-left corner. Dash up one side of the wall, jump to the other side and grab the strawberry, then slide down the wall.

From the seventh room you can spot an opening in the ceiling between two spike-filled walls. Get yourself under the second dream block in the room, dash straight up, move left a bit, then dash straight up again. That gets you into the room above with this strawberry.

In the seventh room, and very tricky: you cannot interact with the falling platform above the berry or it will block the berry off or crush you. Grab onto the walls elevated above the spikes and climb them to jump into the pit with the berry, then quickly dash out and finish the room.

In the eighth room, and the approach depends on whether you took the shortcut mentioned earlier. If you did, simply move right out of your fall into the hole where the strawberry floats. If you did not, it is still reachable: when you come to the large, square-shaped dream block, dash through it diagonally up-right and then dash straight up to reach the berry.

From the eleventh room you can reach a screen transition at the top, in the same column as the fourth dream block from the left. In the room above, dash straight up to find the strawberry, then move left and right, dashing through the dream block as you descend, to avoid dying.

From the eleventh room, another screen transition sits in the same column as the fourth dream block from the right. It is at the bottom, so enter it by dashing straight down from the top of the dream block. In the room below, reach the strawberry by dashing diagonally up-right from below both dream blocks; once you have it, do the same mirrored to return.

In the sixth room the hole in the ceiling still exists and can be entered. Scale another room and you reach the room with the winged strawberry. Jump onto the left spring, then move right in the air and jump across the disappearing platforms to the other spring. Climb the right wall after bouncing on that spring and jump left onto the other disappearing platforms. To reach the winged strawberry you actually need to dash into it — aim slightly higher than where the berry hovers, as it starts flying up when you dash.

The strawberry floats low in the air below the second moving dust bunny. Stay bouncing on the spring until that dust bunny is at its highest, then move right, grab the berry, grab the wall and climb up.

In the third room, and only reachable by exploiting screen transitions. At the end of the room, go back left over the roof; back at the left you can see the strawberry hovering among spikes. Dash diagonally back and forth between this room and the one to the left to reach the platform. Walk off the platform to hit the strawberry, then dash left.

In the sixth room, floating near a cluster of dust bunnies. Stand on the fourth floating platform, at the top-left of the dust bunnies, and walk off to the right when the circling dust bunny moves past Madeline's bottom-right, then dash straight left to land on the green platform.

A hidden area is reached by walking through the bottom-left of the eighth room, the one with the second key. In the room you arrive in, walk into the spring on the floor and grab the falling platform. When it starts falling, jump and grab the next falling platform, then again for the last one, and dash left once that third platform has started to fall. The strawberry is in the room to the left. Jump left when the moving dust bunny on the right is moving up, wait a bit, then jump left again and dash directly left without touching the disappearing platform. Jump off the wall after claiming the strawberry and you can get back by jumping and dashing.

Follow the same route as for the previous berry. A smashable wall is in the ceiling of the room holding berry 4, so dash into that ceiling to continue. In the next room, jump and dash straight left to get past the narrow gap with the dust bunnies. Touch the dash crystal and work your way up the corridor, then dash left at the top and slide down the left wall, jumping before you land in the dust bunnies, and do the same on the wall you land against. After the room transition, complete another room: dash directly into both dash crystals and wait before dashing the last time underneath the floating dust bunny. Then go left to find the strawberry on a balcony above an earlier room.

In the ninth room, a vertical transition sits to the top-left of where Mr. Oshiro is waiting. Wait on the last sinking platform to jump to the floating platform furthest right, then climb up, jump off the right side and dash diagonally up-right to climb the corridor. In the room above, the strategy is simply to dash directly into every dash crystal. Slide down the right wall to grab the strawberry, jump off the wall, then dash left to get back to safety.

A winged strawberry at the end of the eleventh room. Climb the first platform and jump over to the next. Jump to the third platform to climb up and jump over it, then stick to the right side of the fourth platform and jump off. From there, grab the berry.

In the fourteenth room, floating underneath the leftmost sinking platform. Aim to run off the platform while both circling dust bunnies are far away, and grab the wall until you are comfortable dashing out of the pit to climb to safety.

In the fifteenth room, a hidden path sits above where you start. On entering the room, walk into the hole and dash to the left to land on the platform. Go right, dash left again, and slide down the wall, then jump off and land on a lower platform. Jump into the gap between the dust bunnies and dash left to reach the strawberry. To get out, start climbing the left wall and dash to any nearby disappearing platform to refresh your stamina when needed.

The strawberry floats at the top over spikes. From the start of the room, jump across the first set of dust bunnies and climb the wall you reach. Jump off that wall and dash over the next wall to reach the next platform. Jump to the floating platform, then jump at the top to the other side and walljump to the other floating platform. Jump to the platform the berry hovers over, then jump up and dash left. To survive, walljump off the right side of the very first wall you climbed over and climb up the left side of the wall opposite it. To continue the room without dying, walljump off the left and dash diagonally up-right to grab the rightmost floating platform, then jump over to move on.

On the right side of the fifteenth room is a smashable wall in the floor. It takes you to a spot above an earlier room, with two moving dust bunnies in a narrow corridor. Start running right as soon as the dust bunny on the floor starts moving right, then shortly after jump and dash right to reach the berry. Standing on the elevated floor where the strawberry was, dash left as soon as the moving dust bunny on the floor starts moving right, and keep going left quickly to get out.

The third room of the green path has this strawberry hovering near dust bunnies and moving dust bunnies. Walk off the ledge while the dust bunny on the right is also going down, and touch the strawberry. Then quickly dash diagonally up-right and jump off the right wall to cling to the floating platform. Jump straight up and either walljump off the upper area on the right or climb it to get to safety.

In the fifth room of the green path, at the bottom-right. Slide down the wall and dash right to grab the floating platform. Climb up and jump over the top of the platform to get the strawberry, then start climbing the right side of the platform, jump over it again, and when your hitbox is inside the dash crystal, dash straight left and then dash left again. Finish the room normally to claim the berry.

This winged strawberry is protected by dust bunnies in the third room of the purple path. Jump onto each pillar when the dust bunny is moving up and hold onto the sides until the next one does the same — if clutter remains, you can stand on it instead of clinging to the wall. Dash at the end to make the winged strawberry fly up, then jump into it to grab it.
In the fifth room of the purple path, hiding behind some foreground water. Walk off the right side of the floating platform, dash directly left, and climb up to finish the room.

A right transition is in the second room of the brown path — third if you count the room shared with the platform-rearranging button. The room you enter holds the strawberry surrounded by trigger spikes. Climb the first pillar of boxes and dash right after jumping from the apex of your climb, to land on another set of boxes. Jump and dash right again from there, then climb the right wall to collect the berry. When you fall below the set of boxes to the left of the berry, dash directly left to land on part of the set you stepped on before. Jump left to the first set of boxes and dash left over the dust bunnies at the beginning to claim the strawberry.

In the fifth room of the brown path, the path to the strawberry is on the left. Walljump up the first section while dodging moving dust bunnies, and dash diagonally up-left to avoid touching as many dust-bunny-spawning tiles as possible. Walljump up the second section to grab the strawberry, then dash right or up-right as you fall back down. Then safely exit the first section and go through the door.
After pressing any clutter switch, return to the first room. You can then go below where the bridge originally covered and find a room with a strawberry. Avoid the water — dust bunnies are in it.

First, try to land as far right as possible on the first platform elevated over the dust bunnies, and do not move. Jump up and dash left with no motion inputs. Next, jump left and dash straight up to grab the lower ledge. Jump up from there and land on the right side of the ledge. Then jump left, dash directly upward, and steer right to land on the right section of the upper ledge. From here, dash right into the berry and land in the lower area you have not already stood in. Walk left, jumping over the dust bunnies you spawned earlier, then jump left and dash straight up to land on the left side of the lower ledge. Do it again to land on the left side of the upper ledge, then finish the room as normal.

This strawberry is in the room below the cutscene with Oshiro. Walk off the platform right as the moving dust bunny at the bottom reaches the right. Dash right to land as far onto the platform as possible. Jump to the wall and climb it, then jump off and dash straight up to grab the berry, then hold the wall again. Climb up a bit and, when the moving dust bunny reaches the right, jump to the platform to get past the dust bunnies you spawned earlier. Finish the room as normal to claim the berry.

At the start of the long horizontal room containing the key is a gap in the floor. Going down it leads to a room with two strawberries. On the right side, hold onto the wall just under where the moving dust bunnies travel back and forth. When the middle one moves left, dash directly upward, then move right and fall into the gap between two moving dust bunnies. Jump from the left wall to the right and collect the dash crystal, then jump back to the left side and climb the wall. Repeat the first step mirrored to get to safety and claim this strawberry.

In the same room as the previous berry, this one hides behind a cloth on the left. To enter the area, hold the left wall and dash up just as the middle dust bunnies move right. Then move left to land on the floor below. Jump and dash up when the moving dust bunny guarding the strawberry is moving away to grab the berry, then fall back down and land on the lower floor without touching the dust bunnies you spawned earlier. Exit by repeating the entry process mirrored.

In the fifth room, this strawberry requires you to bounce on Oshiro's head to reach it — it sits around a tunnel of dust bunnies and is out of reach without the extra boost. Stand on the right edge of the platform to its left and wait until Oshiro's laser shoots out, then jump and dash up-right and fall through the tunnel to get the berry safely.

Near the start, in a tight corridor between dust bunnies. Dash up from the floor, jump across, and grab the berry without touching the dust bunnies. Another method is to bounce on Oshiro's head to get onto the wall with a dash, then dash through where the berry is to collect it.

Around the middle of the ninth room, a strawberry floats at the bottom. Walk off the left edge, dash right, and climb the wall to get it. Make sure Oshiro will not attack you during this by letting him pass before you walk off.
In the third room, hidden inside a wall. Climb and dash up above the left side of the room, into the gap opposite the wall where the bird is resting.

In the fourth room, floating near the bottom of the screen beside a wall. Jump up the nearby ledge and fall to get the strawberry, then jump off the wall and dash straight up to get back onto the ledge.
In the fifth room, between spikes. Direct the green bubble under the berry, climb the smashable wall, then dash straight up to reach it, and finish the room normally.
At the end of the sixth room, under a ledge. Jump off the left wall to bounce on the cloud and reach the berry, then move back left and bounce back to safety.

In the eighth room, and it looks tricky because heading towards it puts you against the wind. Fall down the corridor in the middle and dash left to reach the strawberry. Walljump off the wall the berry sat beside and use your jumps and climbs carefully so you do not run out of stamina getting back up.
In the ninth room, a smashable wall is visible. Jump left into it and dash straight up to find the strawberry.

Going left in the tenth room, before the cassette room, reaches a room with a seeded strawberry. After you collect one strawberry seed the wind starts blowing left. Grab the rightmost seed first, jump off the right wall, dash diagonally up-left, and land on the spring. Bounce up and dash straight up for the next seed, then climb the platform floating left off the spring and jump carefully over it to collect the third seed at its bottom-left before dashing diagonally again. Using the wind to push you left, jump up the left corridor off the wall to reach the last seed.

In the eleventh room, floating by a platform far from the main wall. When the wind starts blowing, jump up the right wall as far as you can, then dash to the right side of the floating platform and jump above it to grab the berry just as the wind starts blowing again, then pull yourself right as soon as possible.

Going right out of the first room brings you to a room with two strawberries. This first berry is in the open on the right side. Ride the guided platform straight right and dash above the spikes to reach it. Leave the room by riding the lower guided platform back left.

In the same room as the previous berry, a smashable wall sits in the top-right corner. After reaching the right side with the guided platform you used before, fall to the lower guided platform and jump to the right wall, climb it, and dash straight up to break the smashable wall. Hold the wall until the guided platform respawns, jump to it, then finish the room.

Above the guided platform, go right. In this room, bounce on the spring and dash to the triggered platform, then as it goes down, jump over it to the guided platform to its right. Steer that platform right, fall into the strawberry, and ride up the next triggered platform. Grab the triggered platform pointing left when you reach it and ride it to safety.

Go into the lowest transition on the left; this strawberry floats in the middle. Grab the left side of the triggered platform, ride it left, then jump off, dash straight up when the timing is right, and grab the side of the triggered platform as you fall to ride to the end.

This berry first requires going up the left side. To cross the first room, land on the guided platform and steer it up just enough to fit over the wall but under the small platform. Jump over the platform to land on the guided platform again, then steer it downward. Jump and dash straight up to land on the bridge, then continue left. In the following room, jump and dash to the guided platform and steer it right as it rises. A section of green bubbles follows, which is simple, then fall down the left side. In the next room, dash into the green bubble and go right, then dash to the guided platform. Move it right as it rises, then jump to the left wall at the top. Jump off that left wall when the guided platform breaks and finally take the strawberry. You can then go right through an earlier berry room to get back to the main hub.

From the very top transition of the first room you can reach the far side of a later room in the subchapter. Bounce from the pink cloud onto the top of the nearby guided platform. Ride it left, moving it down or up as needed, and you arrive at the left side of the room, where you fall into the bottom transition and find this strawberry hovering above an earlier room.
In the second room. Go through a hidden passage in the water, and the strawberry floats in the open beyond it.

Continuing right from the previous berry by breaking a smashable wall takes you to the Crystal Heart room. From there, dash right through another smashable wall into the room holding this strawberry. Jump onto the first triggered platform to activate it, but make sure to jump to the triggered platform pointing upward to move it out of the way, so the first one can keep moving. When you reach the right, dash directly upward and grab the right side of the next triggered platform. Land on it and carefully dash around the crystals to arrive where the berry sits, at the top-left.

In the fifth room, hovering over spikes on the right. Play through the room normally first, to get the guided platform on a course that crosses the berry. Hold the right side of the guided platform and climb up when you can, then jump to grab the berry while also landing on top of the platform, and move it downward to stay safe as you continue right and finish the room.

Above the left wall of the first room, a left transition leads to a windy room with the first berry. Approach the winged strawberry from the left side by jumping all the way left and then jumping up the wall. Do not jump while holding the wall, as that wastes stamina — a normal jump still gains height thanks to the wind. Walljump to get above the spikes and keep jumping up the higher part of the wall. At the top, jump right and dash right, above where the winged strawberry is, to reach the starting ledge, then climb up to safety.

In the first room, floating under the main platforming area near the start. Walk off the small platform above the berry, and right as you touch it, start moving left and dash diagonally up-left to grab the wall above the spikes. Climb the wall and land on it to claim the berry.

In the fourth room, at the far-right of the screen. Do the whole room normally first and land on the bridge at the end. From there, wait until the triggered platform you used earlier respawns, then go back down to the green bubble and direct it up-left, steering Madeline left to grab onto the triggered platform — that puts you on the platform with a dash still available. Ride it to the right side and jump to the berry, then jump back left and dash into the green bubble to claim the strawberry.

In the fifth room, an alternate path to the left leads to this berry's room. Using the harsh wind, jump left and dash left to be just barely able to reach the strawberry. Jump or climb up the left wall to reach the dash crystal, then jump right and dash diagonally up-right into the next dash crystal, then dash right again to enter the green bubble. Aim the green bubble directly right, then dash diagonally up-right into the last dash crystal, fall down and dash directly right to get back.

In the fifth room, at the end, in a complicated area. Ride the triggered platform right and collect the key token while holding the wall. Jump left and dash at the last moment to reach the touch switch gate, then climb it to get back to safety and claim the berry.

In the eighth room, around the middle, floating among many crystal spikes. Take the closest green bubble directly left and let the wind blow you to the wall. Climb that wall and, when the wind stops, jump left to grab the berry and quickly dash directly right to get back to the wall. From there climb back up, return to the green bubble, and move on as normal.

A hidden room sits to the right of the eighth room, accessed through the slightly cracked part of the right wall above the spikes. The room beyond has many green bubbles, which you aim right and then dash up out of to advance; for the third green bubble, aim it down-right and dash up-right. Walljump up the next corridor and take the green bubbles at the top to the left to finally see the strawberry. Aim the final green bubble directly down to grab the berry, then dash to the side. Hold the wall and climb back up so you can walljump into the green bubble and use it to leave the room.

A smashable wall is on the left of the first room. From the ledge it opens up, dash straight up into a hidden area in the ceiling. The room beyond is large and very tricky to work out. Start by jumping over the guided platform and grabbing its left side, then steer it left as it rises. At the top, jump and dash left to reach the green bubble. Direct the green bubble left, then dash straight up. Grab the right side of the next guided platform and move it left to ride to the top of the next area. At the top, jump to the other side of the next guided platform and grab on, then direct it right as it rises. Jump and dash to reach the next green bubble, direct it right, and ride up the triggered platform; when you can, let go and dash right.
In the second room, underneath a disappearing platform. Advance to the third disappearing platform and fall when it disappears to touch the berry, then dash up-left to get back to safety.

In the fifth room, hovering over crystal spikes near the end. Use the nearby green bubble to launch yourself up, then dash directly left to grab the strawberry and land on an earlier platform. You can claim the berry and continue the room as normal.
In the eighth room, inside a secret area reached by directing the second green bubble upward.

In the tenth room, near the end, among some green bubbles. Take the second-to-last green bubble directly right to reach the berry, immediately dash straight upward into the other green bubble, then ride it to the end of the room as normal.

Going left out of the first room brings you to the area seen at the end of Chapter 4, with the gondola at the ledge. Walk off that ledge, head back right, then dash diagonally up-right into the suspicious hole in the mountain and the area holding this strawberry.
In the fifth room there is a hidden smashable wall to the left of the red bubble you would normally use to get to the upper section. The strawberry is behind that wall.

In the fifth room, in the top left. Use the uppermost red bubble to go left and grab the wall. Jump and grab the next piece of wall on the left, then jump and climb the right wall. Walljump off the top and collect the berry, then fall through a gap on the left before dashing directly right to get back to safety.

Go from the lower section of the fifth room to the bottom left to find the room with this strawberry. To get across, jump onto the spring on the swap block, then dash left to bounce on it again before grabbing the wall and the berry. Dash diagonally up-right so you end up above where the swap block will arrive, then bounce on the spring. Move right to land on the spring again as it moves back right, then dash right and climb up to the starting area.
Go right from the previous berry's room to find another berry room. Use the red bubble to go up, dash right at the top, take the other red bubble left, then dash directly down at the gap on the left.

Enter the bottom-right transition of the fifth room to reach this berry's room. Jump on top of the first swap block, then for the next one dash straight up between the two swap blocks and land below where the swap block just moved away from. Quickly dash again, get below the third swap block, and reach the strawberry. Dash again to move the swap block and return left with one more dash. Jump up and dash directly up between the first and second swap block and grab the second one, then jump off it to the left to get back.

Two rooms below the fifth room, floating in the top middle among many spinners. Stand on either of the swap blocks and face towards the berry. Hit dash and immediately move towards the berry — you will be shot far past it, grabbing it on the way and landing safely.

Going to the left transition two rooms below the fifth room reaches this strawberry's room. First jump and dash into where the swap block will arrive, then cling to it. Collect the dash crystal and hold the wall. For a consistent strategy, jump off the wall and dash directly up back into the dash crystal, then dash directly left to grab the other swap block. Jump off that one to reach the strawberry. To return safely, jump right and keep going right with a diagonal up-right dash to grab the ledge — or walljump off the left swap block for more safety.

Going to the right transition two rooms below the fifth room reaches this strawberry's room. Stand on the swap block lined up with the vertical gap between the spinners. Dash directly downward onto it, then jump just after for a huge upward boost, letting you dash directly up into the red bubble. Take that bubble right and dash straight down onto the strawberry, steering left to enter another red bubble. Ride that right and dash down when you reach the gap to the lower area to claim the berry safely.

From the sixth room, go up to the top transition to find this strawberry's room. To do that, walljump off the left area, dash directly up and grab the right side of the floating platform, then jump right onto the swap block and boost yourself with a jump at the end of its return. In the room above, jump and dash diagonally up-right above where the first swap block will move to, then grab its right side. Jump off into the dash crystal and grab the other swap block. Jump off that swap block and make a diagonal up-right dash to grab it on the other side of the crystal, which gets you to the top and the strawberry.

Go left from the eighth room by riding a red bubble to reach a room with the berry floating on the left side. Jump over the swap block and grab its left side, then dash into it. At the left side, jump off the swap block, grab the strawberry, hit the dash crystal, then dash right and grab the swap block to go back.

In the ninth room there is a hidden area inside the central platform. Look for the chunk of platform dented inward and dash directly up from the red bubble after riding it left a little. Inside is a dash switch that unlocks a temple gate in a hidden lower area of the room. Hit it, then finish the room as normal. Ride the red bubble in the following room right, then up. The next room has a couple of touch switches to collect, which unlock the temple gate guarding the berry. For the left key token, ride the bottom red bubble up, dash out to enter the second red bubble and aim that one up-left into the next red bubble; aim that one down, then dash directly right and climb the wall. For the right key token, ride the second red bubble up-right and at the end dash directly right to reach the right red bubble; aim it at the key token and hold the wall after collecting it until the bubble respawns, then ride it back left. Try to fall inside the initial gap, using a direct upward dash to reposition if needed. Then go right from the starting area and claim the strawberry.

Above the left side of the first room is a hidden gap to another room. In there, go to the red bubble and take it right to grab the strawberry, then quickly dash straight down. Steer slightly left and take the bottom red bubble left before dashing up to get to safety.
In the second room, a transition sits in the middle of the floor. Stand on the swap block in that room, then dash and move right to launch yourself to the wall, and climb it to reach the strawberry.

Going to the left side of the second room above the entrance finds an area with some spinners and a swap block. Dash to the swap block, hold on, then jump up the corridor when you arrive. In the room you reach, go to the top left. To get the winged strawberry in the next room, ride up the first two red bubbles to the ceiling, then move left during your descent to reach the next one. For the third, ride it left and work your way up the left area before dashing diagonally into the winged strawberry. Dash right as you fall; getting out is easy by riding the red bubbles up and dashing between them.

In the ceiling of the second room, near the right, is a gap to the upper room. It can be tricky: jump right from the ledge and dash right to hold the swap block, and let go right as the other swap block returns to the left. From there, jump right and dash diagonally up-right to get above where the third swap block was, and climb up to where the strawberry hovers.
Reached through another gap in the ceiling, to the left of the one used for the previous berry.

Going to the top-left of the fourth room finds a transition to another berry room. Jump and dash diagonally up-left to reach the red bubble and ride it left. Go to the next red bubble up-right and keep moving right after collecting the strawberry. Dash into the next red bubble and take it right, then dash down before hitting the spinners.

Going to the top-right of the fourth room finds another transition to a berry room. Ride the red bubble at the start to the right and, before hitting the spinners, dash diagonally up-right to grab the wall and the dash refill. Jump off the wall and dash diagonally up-right again, then climb that wall to reach the other red bubble. Direct it left and dash diagonally up-left before reaching the spinners. Land in the small gap in the floor where there are no spinners, then get back to the entrance.

At the bottom of the fourth room is a transition on the left side. Dash in place to activate the swap blocks, then quickly run left to fall into the gap in the floor. Jump left out of the gap when the swap blocks return to normal. Hold the swap block and dash to get the momentum to jump off and land where the strawberry is.

Going right at the bottom of the fourth room, there are 2 gaps in the floor, both leading to the same berry room. Walk off the platform and move towards the centre to grab the middle wall. Jump above the wall to the other side and grab the wall again. Jump off and dash into a red bubble to take you back to the start of the room.

Go 2 rooms right from the bottom of the fourth room; from there the top-right transition leads to a strawberry. Dash to where the lower swap block is going to be and jump over the spinner as the swap block moves back. Do the same for the next swap block, then dash up on the right side to reach the transition.

Follow the steps for the previous berry, but instead of heading for the top-left transition, go for the dash switch on the ceiling above the second swap block. That opens the temple gate on the right, which leads to a seeded strawberry. Dash directly up into the leftmost seed and climb the wall. Jump off the wall, climb the swap block, and jump above it to both grab the next seed and land on the spring. Then either move right from the spring and dash to the wall to climb to the last seed, or boost yourself right by dashing from the swap block. In the lower-right corner of this area, dashing into the cracked wall opens a transition to the area with the cassette.
In the sixth room. Lure the Seeker into the red wall on the right to break it, which exposes this strawberry and a spring.

In the third room, in the section opposite the left key path, reached by going below the initial entrance. Dash left into the red bubble and ride it left a little, then dash directly up. Hold the wall or swap block, then land on top of the swap block. Next, dash diagonally up-left to where the other swap block will arrive and land on it, then crouch until it returns to the left; when you uncrouch you collect this strawberry. To get back, dash directly up in the tiny corridor and fall to the red bubble, then take it back right.

Go to the top-left transition of the second room to find a secret room. Fall down and dash right into the red bubble, then take it left. When you are in the middle of both swap blocks, dash left out of the red bubble. That reaches a section above the third room with this strawberry above a disappearing platform. Important: this passage can only be entered once, so get the berry the first time you reach it or you will need to restart the chapter.

In the room right of the second room, go to the bottom right for a secret gap in the spikes leading to another berry room. Distract the Seeker in the lower area so you can hop between the tiny safe patches of ground and reach the strawberry, then do the same on the way back.

In the same section that leads to the previous berry. Hold the swap block and dash to launch yourself to another swap block. Jump off that one into the dash refill, then dash diagonally up-right into the other swap block and climb to the section above. The path from there leads right to the strawberry.

A strawberry can be seen by the red bubble on the right of the second room, which would otherwise carry you across the spikes much further left. Under that red bubble is a smashable wall, destroyable only by aiming the bubble downward — which opens access to the strawberry.

Collect all 3 keys, cross the gap in the third room — meaning you still hold 1 key when entering the red bubble — and go down to the next room, where that key unlocks the lock guarding this strawberry. Alternatively you can hold 1 key while skipping the bubble with an extended super.

In the sixth room, and it needs the Theo Crystal and the Seeker together. Get to the end of the room, where the strawberry is above, and lure the Seeker over. Get a good bounce off the Seeker and use the height to throw Theo into the dash switch on the wall inside the spinners. That opens the temple gate blocking the berry, letting you dash straight up to it.
In the third room, dash into a gap in the spinners to reach the berry room. You can grab the berry immediately, but then you have to navigate a room full of spinners to find a safe space to bank it.

In the fifth room, dash into the enclave in the ceiling at the end platform to find a room with two berries — this one and berry 3. For the left berry, dash up to a spring that launches you into a wall, then use your 2 dashes to grab it and land back on the platform to collect it. For the right berry, dash up and walljump your way into a Dash Refill, then drop down to grab the berry and dash onto the starting platform. The source gives one description covering both berries in the room and does not say which is numbered which.

The second of the two berries in the ceiling enclave off the fifth room. For the right berry, dash up and walljump your way into a Dash Refill, then drop down to grab the berry and dash onto the starting platform to collect it. For the left berry, dash up to a spring launching you into a wall, then use your 2 dashes to grab it and land back on the platform. The source gives one description covering both berries in the room and does not say which is numbered which.
In the sixth room, hovering above spinners, so you have to dash above some platforms with spikes. Once you pick it up, complete the rest of the room — or return to its beginning — to collect it.

In the third room. Dash left after jumping off the zip mover and land on another one. Wait for it to return, then jump up to collect the berry and either return to the platform you started from or continue on the alternate path.
At the end of the first room on the alternate path. Ride the zippers up, then bounce on the spring to reach and collect this berry.

To the left of berry 6's location, a small bridge sits on the left wall; beyond it is a hidden passage to another room with this berry. After walking off the jump-through, dash left into the zip mover. Ride it up and fling Madeline upward, then dash left and reach the wall. Jump off the wall and ride the other zip mover to reach the wall, climb it, and collect the berry.

This winged berry is at the right of the fourth room on the main path. Use the spring to launch Madeline right and dash to go over the platform where the berry is, intercepting it while it is flying away.

In the eighth room, hovering around some falling platforms. Make the left block fall and climb the wall to grab this berry. Then make the rightmost block fall and use the spring attached to it to reach the end of the room and collect the berry.
In the final, ninth room, hiding beyond the Badeline Booster at the end. Skip the booster, then climb the walls on the right until you find a hole leading to the area with this berry.

To the left of the fourth room. Use two Dream Blocks to reach the berry. To get back, dash into the first dash refill, then dash up and right twice to reach the second. Then dash into the wall, dash up and left into the dream block, and use your dashes to get back to safe ground.
To the right of the fifth room. Dash up diagonally through the Dream Block, grab the strawberry, then dash down diagonally to collect it.
Behind the fake wall hidden on the left path. Dash directly right into the dream block adjacent to the right wall.

To the left of the seventh room. Dash to the left wall and do an up-right dash followed by an up-left dash to get up the dream blocks. Then fall down, avoiding some spikes, to reach and collect the berry.
In the eighth room, above the second dream block, in a suspicious hidden area reached by dashing left over the spikes above.
Found just after the final Badeline Booster, inside an oddly textured smashable wall.
In the first room of 1500 M. It requires difficult timing to dash past 3 Dust Bunnies on the way to this berry.
In a hole in the third room, between some Dust Bunnies. After falling down, use timing to navigate more dust bunnies and a sinking platform to collect it.

Hidden below berry 18's room, reached by falling into a hole between some Dust Bunnies. To collect it, activate four touch switches so the platform blocking the strawberry can move; a good way is to activate them from left to right. It is important not to touch too many walls, as they all have Dust Triggers on them, which makes it impossible to touch the same wall twice. It is also important to conserve your dash and stamina where you can.

In the fifth room, in the middle at the bottom, surrounded by dust bunnies. Stand on the jumpthrough below, dash right into the berry, then quickly dash left and grab the wall. Climb it to reach safety and claim the strawberry.
In the sixth room, near a circling dust bunny and the dash refill. Once you grab the berry, replenish your dashes at the dash refill, then complete the room to collect it.

To the left of the eighth room. Dash up-left as soon as the first dust bunny moves towards the right. After collecting the first dash refill, dash up-left then straight up; drifting left should get you past the second dust bunny, where you collect another dash refill and dash past the dust bunny into the strawberry. Finally, use the spring to launch yourself back to the starting platform.

Beneath a smashable wall at the end of the eighth room. To collect it, drop down from the starting platform, dash right, then dash up. Repeat that, collect the berry, then immediately dash up to hit the spring. Dash left twice to get back to the starting platform.

In the tenth room there is a gap in the ceiling leading to the room with this winged berry. To collect it, use the springs while avoiding the Dust Bunnies. At the end, dash to the final spring, then twice more, to reach the room where you can intercept and collect this berry.

Above the second room, a small gap sits in the ceiling on the left side. Go into the left screen transition and dash up back into the second room to get into that gap. Inside is a room filled with pink clouds and spinners; jump right after you land on the pink clouds so you are not bounced into the spinners, and you can easily make it to the end of the room where the strawberry floats.

In the fifth room, floating at the far right below the ending bridge. Get to the left ledge just below, dash straight right, then straight up and hold the wall. Climb high and wait for a snowball to come at you, then jump onto it or let it hit you from below, then dash straight right twice to climb the right wall and collect the berry.

In the seventh room, and one of the trickiest berries in the game. Ride the triggered platform up for a bit, and after passing the crumble block you need to stall precisely in the air and dash into the dash refill at the same moment the triggered platform is there. Jump off and dash straight up into the strawberry, then repeat the process when the triggered platform comes back. Finally, dash straight up and then straight right to land back on the triggered platform, and finishing the room collects the strawberry.

In the eighth room, go to the left transition to find a room with this winged strawberry. Jumping from the right ledge gets you to the left floating platform. Jump right and climb to the top of the right floating platform before jumping all the way left. With a straight left dash and then a quick straight up dash, you can catch the winged strawberry before it flies away.

In the room holding the previous strawberry, a smashable wall is visible in the ceiling, leading to another berry room. Above that room is yet another secret berry room, reached by leading the guided platform at the start to the left and riding it to the top transition of the screen. The room that follows is a seeded strawberry challenge. As with Chapter 4's seeded strawberry, once you collect a seed the wind starts blowing left. Go to the top-right of the screen and dash into the nearby seed. Fall into the dash refill, then dash diagonally up-left and jump constantly up the wall to save stamina; at the top, move right to collect the next seed. Jump off that wall onto the right side of the floating platform, jump over it, and go left to climb the left wall into the final seed.

Located below the room of the previous strawberry and above the room of strawberry 4. Approach the guided platform with a straight-up dash and then a straight-right dash. Guide it right as it rises and fall into the green bubble. Direct that bubble up-right, then a straight up and straight right dash gets you to the other green bubble. Launch that one straight upward, then fall down and dash right through the gap in the spinners to reach the berry.

In the ninth room, and very straightforward. As the wind carries you right, you can see this strawberry in a small gap in the spinners — dash straight into it, then up-right into the green bubble, and complete the room normally from there.

In the eleventh room. At the end of the room, where the Badeline booster would carry you to the next subchapter, avoid the purple orb and dash right underneath it into the suspicious cracked wall with no spinners on it. The strawberry is hidden in that area.

Riding the first red bubble left — or simply dashing into the smashable wall it breaks — reaches a room with this strawberry. Stand on the bridge above and dash onto the floor, then quickly run off the bridge and land in the red bubble. Take it left and, as soon as you reach the wall, jump right and grab the swap block. Let go right as it arrives back at the top and you are flung into the air. With both dashes available in the section above, dash left to get the berry, then dash back right to claim it.

In the first room, in the middle of the room under the usual red bubble path. Dash straight down into the gap in the spikes as you pass it in the red bubble, then dash diagonally up-right to land on the disappearing platform. Jump up and do an upward, then diagonally up-right dash out of the area to another disappearing platform, then dash into the nearby red bubble.
In the same room as the key above the fifth room, but on the left side instead of the right. Take the red bubble path two rooms below on the left to get to the strawberry's location.

At the start of the sixth room, ride the first red bubble straight up to reveal a hidden path above. The strawberry is at the end of the first room you enter, above a disappearing platform. Make your way to the spring on the right and try to grab the wall above it. When the swap block is about halfway back to its original position, bounce on the spring and hold onto the swap block; from there you can dash to the berry.

After finishing the room holding the previous strawberry, two more rooms have to be completed. In the first, carefully time jumping and dashing up into dash switches while avoiding blades, then do the same again with springs. The strawberry is in the second room after. Its first challenge just has you dashing on a swap block and launching yourself forward by jumping right after; then comes some careful dash timing around blades.
In the twelfth room, in a hidden area near the middle. Below the swap block that is meant to launch you up to the last two swap blocks, a hidden passage is revealed by entering from the left side.

Right by the red bubble you ride up into the purple orb are a few secret areas. To the top-left of the red booster is a dash switch. To the top-right is a temple gate that the switch opens, protecting another dash switch. To the bottom-right of the red bubble, this strawberry sits behind a temple gate that the top-right dash switch unlocks.
To the bottom-left of the red bubble at the end of the twelfth room, the wall reveals a hidden section with this strawberry.
Amid flag 26's platforming, this strawberry floats under a platform. Dash right into it, then straight up, and touch the nearby dash refill to continue onward and claim it.

At the end of flag 24, a strawberry sits to the left of where flag 23 would be entered. From the crumble block below, jump left and dash leftward, then start climbing the wall. At the top of the wall, jump right to get the strawberry and clear the spikes, then dash right to land on the crumble block and get to safety.

Near the start of flag 21, above the normal path among some spikes. Bounce off the spring and dash straight up to climb the right side of the thin floating platform. Jump and dash into the strawberry, then jump back left. Finally, jump over the floating platform and keep going left to get back to the flag.

To the left of flag 18 is a section with a lot of spinners and this strawberry. Do a full bounce up from the nearby cloud and move left, over the spinners. Using your two dashes, carefully time boosting yourself up to reach the strawberry without touching the spinners. Afterwards, fall into the dash refill and make your way back to the cloud.

A strawberry hovers to the bottom-right of flag 16. Do a diagonal dash into it after falling from the bridge, then diagonally dash the other way and wrap Madeline around the thin section of wall to grab its left side and climb back up to safety.

To the left of flag 15, beyond the tall wall of spinners, this berry floats near the left wall. Do a full jump and then dash diagonally up-left over the spinners to reach the strawberry, then climb the wall and dash diagonally up-right back over the spinners.

This strawberry hovers above the main path of flag 4, though it is worth reaching flag 3 as a breather point before going for it. A feather is needed to reach the area. If you go for the berry while completing flag 4, the feather used there can be carried upward to reach the small disappearing platform; if you go after saving at flag 3, the feather found just above can be brought down and to the left to give access. Jump onto the small disappearing platform, dash diagonally up-left over the block of spinners, and grab the left side of the floating platform. From there, jump to the disappearing platforms on the left and reach the strawberry, then ride the feather below onward as normal and claim the strawberry when you land.

To the left of the fifth room is a room with this strawberry floating far to the left near some fireballs. It is completely out of reach while the room is hot — though it can technically be obtained with a precise skip — so turn the Core to cold and come back. The hot bumper above the starting area will have become a bumper you can dash into diagonally up-right, bouncing you over to the ice balls on the left. Bounce across those carefully to collect the strawberry, then make your way back right and use your other dash to return.

At the end of the first room, a transition at the top of the right side is blocked by a magma barrier. To get past it, continue into the next room until you reach the hot/cold switch, hit it, and bounce back left on the ice balls it creates. Get back to the first room of the subchapter, then dash up to the vertical transition. In the room above, many bumpers sit over a spike floor, with corridors above them surrounded by ice walls; this strawberry is in the farthest right of those ice wall corridors. There are many ways in, but the most reliable is to walljump off the floating platform's ice walls to get to the bumper area without using a dash, then use both dashes to reach the strawberry. You can also barely reach the area by bouncing on the rightmost bumper and walljumping. From there, bounce on the top-left side of the right bumper and move left safely, returning to the start with either the earlier walljumping or a risky bounce on the left side of the leftmost bumper.
In the third room, at the end of the room floating at the top. After being bounced by the last bumper in the room, you should be in range to dash straight up into the strawberry and collect it.

Above the fourth room, reached through a small hole not far to the left of the hot/cold switch. It is easy to enter while the room is cold, but that blocks the strawberry off with an ice barrier and forces you to go left and restart the prior room — you need to enter while it is hot. Bounce on some ice balls near the hot/cold switch while still holding both dashes to reach it and set the room to hot. Then start moving left with dashes, stalling properly until there is an opening past any fireballs. After that the berry is there to collect, and you can head right to fall to the end of the lower room.

In the seventh room, hovering to the right of the last launching block. It looks very hard to approach, since normally you run out of time or stamina and fall into the magma below. The key: after being flung from the launching block on the left, use your other dash to get to where the strawberry floats, then walljump up — do NOT hold the climb button while doing this, or you will activate the launching block. Just walljump back and forth and jump above the top of the launching block so you can grab its left side and finish the room, claiming the strawberry.

items.label: Clear all eight C-Sides
items.note: Three to four rooms each, no checkpoints, ending in a Yellow Crystal Heart. Earns Thanks For Playing.

items.label: Open Core C-Side's 23-heart door
items.note: Core's C-Side sits behind a Heart Door needing 23 crystal hearts, and the other seven C-Sides open the Crystal Heart Gate inside it. Completing it unlocks Variant Mode.

items.label: Clear the Prologue
items.note: No collectables and no achievement, but it unlocks Chapter 1.

items.label: Red strawberries
items.note: 6 in Start, 9 in Crossing, 5 in Chasm.

items.label: Cassette Tape
items.note: In Chasm. Unlocks 1B and earns Gateway — this is the first cassette in play order.

items.label: Crystal Heart
items.note: At the satellite in Crossing, behind the six-colour dash code. Earns Pointless Machines.

items.label: Clear the A-Side
items.note: Earns Forsaken.

items.label: Clear the B-Side
items.note: Earns Sever the Skyline.

items.label: Pass the 15-heart door in Event Horizon
items.note: Needs all 8 blue hearts plus every B-Side except Core's, though it is bypassable.

items.label: Moon Berry
items.note: In the final checkpoint: go left after the last power box, then a death exploit into a long jellyfish room. Earns Wow.

items.label: Clear Farewell
items.note: The final room is the longest in the game — expect 1.5 to 2 hours on a first attempt. Earns Farewell.

items.label: Red strawberries
items.note: 9 in Start, 8 in Intervention, 1 in Awake. Includes the game's first seeded strawberry.

items.label: Cassette Tape

items.label: Crystal Heart
items.note: Straight up from the spawn point, before you go underground. Earns Resurrections.

items.label: Clear the A-Side
items.note: Earns Archaeology.

items.label: Clear the B-Side
items.note: Earns Black Moonrise.

items.label: Crystal Heart
